items.title: Wardel Quezergue Interview, 1995-10-25
items.q: It's gone too far back for me, Ted, for me to remember things like that.

ctx.x: That way. The way we heard it and you, or it was written as more of a ballad and you, you changed it to.

I don't recall, honestly. Um, if it was more in a ballad style, maybe I did. I really don't recall. It's gone too far back for me, Ted, for me to remember things like that. But I do know, you know, I have a habit of sometime I hear something and if the change is for the better, if the people like it, then we'll use it. I do know, I drive it the same way with Groove Me, you know.
